title: Dorm quarter: park and second block
question: Pick one from A (how the park joins the courtyard) and one from B (where the second block goes).

media.caption: Top-down sketches, drawn to scale from the island layout in the code (1 unit = 1.5 m). Nothing is built yet. This is today: the courtyard is about 15 × 10 m, the east lane's pocket park 11 × 16 m, and the field north of Eric's block (about 37 × 52 m) is empty.

Blockout mood view, eye level: walking in from the courtyard through the gap between Eric's block and dorm 5, into the park's south gate. Wisteria shelter on the left, play corner on the right, a cherry with a ring seat in the middle. Plain boxes only.
Blockout mood view, eye level: from the play corner looking west across the cherry square to dorm 5's new door on the park (B1).

options.label: a1. Full merge: one dorm quarter
options.note: Courtyard, east lane, park, dorm row and inner court become one walkable place (about 86 × 78 m). The loop goes dorm street, courtyard, park, inner court, dorm row and back with no fade. Measured cost: phone load about 6.3 to 7 s against the 6 s limit, so it needs trimming before it ships.

options.label: a2. Park only: the courtyard grows north
options.note: The courtyard and the park are one place (about 43 × 57 m); the east lane stays separate and the gate fade stays. The same loop is there on the ground but crosses three fades. Lighter on the phone than a1.

options.label: b1. Dorm 5 becomes the new hires' dorm
options.note: Dorm 5 already stands here as scenery. It gets a ground floor and a door on the park's east-west axis. Its rooms face east over the park, which fits Aoi's bio (single room in the new hires' dorm, facing east).

options.label: b2. A new block north of the park
options.note: A new three-storey block (about 21 × 8 m) on the park's north side, its door on the park's north-south axis. Its rooms face south, so only an end room would face east for Aoi. One more building to model and load.
